name: ACS (Independent)
summary: Leading Methodist independent school with IB Diploma and IP options.
body: ACS (Independent) offers IP and IB Diploma routes within the local independent sector. Popular among families eligible for local schools who still want IB. Distinct from ACS International — confirm which ACS entity you mean in conversations. Ask how orientation week half-days and parent briefings are scheduled for dual-career households, and whether PH observance matches the campus calendar.
